These are the questions you worked out by hand. This time
[Gemini](https://gemini.google.com) writes the SQL. Copy each block (use the
copy button in its top right corner) and paste it into Gemini. Run the blocks
in order in the same chat: the table schemas tell Gemini what your tables look
like, so they have to go first.

Then copy the query Gemini writes into the DoltHub SQL editor for your retail
orders brief database and run it. Check the result against your answer by
hand. If they don't match, work out which one is wrong.

## Table schemas

Paste this first. It shows the three tables, their columns, and how they
connect.

```sql
CREATE TABLE customers (
  customer_id int NOT NULL,
  first_name varchar(255),
  last_name varchar(255),
  PRIMARY KEY (customer_id)
);

CREATE TABLE products (
  product_id int NOT NULL,
  name varchar(255),
  price decimal(10,2),
  PRIMARY KEY (product_id)
);

CREATE TABLE orders (
  order_id int NOT NULL,
  customer_id int NOT NULL,
  product_id int NOT NULL,
  order_date date,
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers (customer_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products (product_id)
);
```

## Worked example

The answer should be the Cotton T-Shirt, the Silk Blouse, and the Cashmere
Sweater, in that order.

```default
Show the name and price of every product Jane Smith ordered, sorted from lowest price to highest.
```

## Question 1

```default
Show the first_name and last_name of every customer who placed an order between 2025-03-15 and 2025-03-21. List each customer only once.
```

## Question 2

```default
For every order of a product that costs more than $80, show the customer's first_name, the product's name, and the order_date.
```

## Question 3

```default
For each product that was ordered at least once, show its name and total_revenue, its price times the number of times it was ordered, sorted from highest total_revenue to lowest.
```

## Question 4

```default
Show the first_name and num_orders of every customer who placed more than one order.
```

## Question 5

```default
Show the first_name and last_name of every customer who has never ordered the Cotton T-Shirt.
```
